patterns.note: A prominent full-width hero section integrates the primary search bar directly into a large background image, immediately setting the site's core function.

A vibrant red (#FF1A1A) is consistently used as the primary accent color for the Yelp logo, all call-to-action buttons, and interactive links, creating strong brand recognition and guiding user attention.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text and search elements as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of depth.
The main navigation bar and search input are fixed at the top of the viewport from the initial load, providing persistent access to core functionalities without changing appearance on scroll.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with clear, bold headings and a grid-based layout for displaying user-generated content cards and category links.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect to add visual depth, likely achieved with CSS transforms or JavaScript scroll listeners.

The primary navigation bar and search interface are implemented as a sticky header, fixed to the top of the viewport from the initial page load, ensuring constant accessibility without any transformation on scroll.
Content sections and cards appear to load statically without significant scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins or slide-ups, relying on clear visual hierarchy for content presentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif for the hero statement, with clear, bold section headings (~2x body) and legible body text for reviews and descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on input fields, buttons, and content cards, creating a friendly and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with clear vertical rhythm between sections and within content blocks, allowing content to breathe without feeling sparse.

standout: Yelp's design is distinctive for its highly functional, content-rich layout that prioritizes user-generated content and local search. The integration of a prominent, full-width hero image with an embedded search bar immediately communicates its purpose, while the consistent use of its iconic red creates strong brand recognition. The site effectively balances a vast amount of information with a clean, navigable interface.
